name: SpecWarp
description: Vital-inspired spectral stretch and smear FX. Input is FFT'd, warped in the frequency domain, then resynthesized. X = Stretch (frequency-axis warp for metallic/ambient textures), Y = Smear (magnitude blur and phase diffusion), Depth/MIX = dry/wet. Feed drum loops for instant otherworldly ambience.

params.name: STRCH
params.detail: Spectral stretch: remaps the frequency axis (0.2x–8x)

params.name: SMEAR
params.detail: Spectral smear: blurs magnitudes and diffuses phase
